description: Stores receipt artwork decomposed into three composable layers for native controls: a static scene (backdrop, mascot, tabletop, towel, produce bag) with the receipt footprint removed; a BLANK receipt paper (all printed UI removed, texture restored) that may grow taller through one stretch slice; and a small foreground overlap (glove, two lime rays, and the soft shadows they cast on the paper). Prepared for founder review; NOT imported by the app.
status: Founder visual approval received 2026-09-30 (layers and the upward-growth demonstration; the paper top may rise above the blue backdrop). Imported by the Stores step only (src/components/onboarding/retailers-step.tsx); the production bytes are unchanged from the export.

measuredPage.note: Mode of rows 395-410 and 1445-1500. The scene exterior is keyed to transparent and its antialiased top/bottom edges unmatted against this measured cream; the app token background/page #FDFCF6 (253,252,246) is 1-2 units darker, so those edge pixels carry at most that difference.

layers.coordinateSpace: Source pixels (934-wide reference). Native: scale every layer by (scene width in pt) / 934 — the same uniform factor for all three.

overlap.note: Fixed to the scene (never moves with paper growth).

paperStretch.rule: Grow UPWARD only: keep the paper bottom at scene row 930 (same x offset), draw the top cap and bottom part 1:1, and stretch only the slice vertically. Never draw the paper shorter than its exported height.
paperStretch.why: The receipt flares wider toward its foot (left edge x 305 -> 268, right edge 816 -> 844 over its height). Anchoring the bottom keeps the flare, teeth, table contact shadows and glove contact exactly where the scene expects them; every row above only ever moves onto a region that is narrower or equal, so the scene footprint stays covered. Growing downward slides narrower rows over the wide foot and exposes scenery that does not exist.

backdropBudget.note: The paper top can rise this far before any column of it leaves the blue backdrop (~11 pt at 402 pt wide). Beyond that the paper top stands over the page cream (shown at +120 px in the stretch demo). Whether that is acceptable, or the native layout should add height another way, is a founder decision.

paperStretch.sliceChoice: Rows 506-830: below the tear shading and the crease at row 504, above the glove (from ~826). The left edge is vertical there (x 304.7-305.5, the <=0.75 px lean is covered by the scene safety ring) and the right edge only widens downward. The rays sit over this slice; they are in the overlap, so the stretched paper simply passes beneath them.

operations.silhouette: Per-row side edges and per-column top/bottom edges measured from the reference (integral subpixel estimate from local outside/inside colours), gaps where the glove, rays or low-contrast background hide the edge filled by linear interpolation of measured rows. Edge-pixel coverage is data-driven from local refs where visible, geometric where occluded; a side-edge colour check re-derived coverage for 363 pixels where interpolation had reached into the bag or towel.
operations.printedUiRemoval: Ink core = paper pixels > 22 units from paper colour in x>=352, rows 530-1312 (459 components); footprint = ink core dilated 5 px (4-connected), where the measured halo ends by 3-4 px. Restored by Poisson (gradient-domain) fill guided by donor texture copied from clean paper strips (<=96 px wide), boundary = surrounding original paper. Removes Popular stores, 2 selected, Clear, six names, checkboxes/checkmarks, dotted rules, Search all stores and the magnifier.
operations.underArt: Paper beneath the glove and rays (art + 10 px ring, 6153 px) restored the same way, bounded by the un-shadowed paper around it.
operations.castShadows: Within 72 px of the glove/rays, the smooth shadow they cast on the paper (Gaussian 0.8-2.5 px local mean against a harmonic estimate of the unshadowed paper) is separated as minimal-alpha colour and moved to the overlap; the paper under it is the exact un-compositing of that shadow, so its own texture is kept (not replaced). Max shadow alpha 0.42; residual alpha at the zone boundary 0.011.
operations.overlap: Solid glove/ray pixels over the paper: original RGB, alpha 255. 10 px ring: exact unmix against the restored paper and shadow (smallest in-gamut alpha). Shadow: alpha + colour from the separation. Only pixels over the paper are included; the rest of the glove and rays stay in the scene.
operations.sceneKey: Welcome/States key: flood from the crop top row (limited to rows < 520) and the bottom row 1438 through near-cream pixels; soft edge unmatted against the measured cream. Receipt footprint (paper alpha 255) cleared to alpha 0; paper edge-band pixels hold the background side of the matte; a 2 px opaque safety ring of nearest-background colour lies just inside the footprint (hidden under the paper).
operations.edgeMatte: Paper edge pixels: coverage a split so a*paper + (1-a)*scene reproduces the source. a>=0.5: scene = nearest background, paper unmatted; otherwise paper = nearest interior paper, scene solved; background tint pushed to the scene side where that stays exact.
operations.nearOpaqueLift: Existing contract: alpha 240-254 set to 255 with the source RGB (not unmatted).
operations.colour: Pure Node zlib decode/encode (no colour management); explicit sRGB + gAMA + cHRM, no ICC/text/time chunks. @napi-rs/canvas (existing devDependency) only lays out the review sheets. No dependency added; scripts lived in the session scratchpad.
operations.nothingRegenerated: No pixel of the mascot, face, glove, rays, feet, foods, bag, towel or tabletop was repainted, recoloured, sharpened, resampled or upscaled. Opaque scene pixels outside the receipt are byte-identical to the reference; opaque overlap art is byte-identical.

repairFootprints.paperCoordinates: masks/lotly-stores-receipt-paper-repair-footprints.png (red = printed UI, green = under glove/rays, blue = cast-shadow separation, white = silhouette edge)

recomposition.note: Page cream + scene + paper + overlap at original geometry vs the reference, max channel error per pixel over the scene rectangle.

limitations: Growing the paper downward is not supported (exposes nonexistent scenery); growth is upward only, with ~26 source px before the paper top leaves the blue backdrop.

The scene cannot be shown without the paper: the receipt footprint is transparent (nothing hidden behind the receipt was invented). A stacked layout can draw scene + paper + overlap at default geometry as a decorative hero.
Under the glove the restored paper shows a faint outline at 4x contrast (1-2 units at 1x); it is hidden by the glove whenever the overlap is drawn.

298 paper edge pixels kept the source mixed colour on both sides of the matte and 22 partial-alpha edge pixels on the right edge still carry a bag/cucumber tint (alpha <= 166). Exact over the scene; faintly visible only if the paper is drawn on its own.
Scene top edge is matted against the reference cream (254,253,248), 1-2 units lighter than the app token; recomposition error there is <= 7 on a few pixels.
The torn top edge keeps its warm fibre tint (e.g. 253,220,184) — original paper art, not a halo.
